emails.subject: Strategic plan update: July checkpoint and what I need from each of you
emails.body:
Hi all,

As we close out July, I want to share where we stand on the 2026-2028 strategic plan and ask for a few inputs before the next cycle.

Three of our five initiatives are on track: the member digital experience refresh, the indirect auto lending expansion, and the branch staffing model. The core conversion readiness work is slightly behind because of vendor scheduling on CoreBanking, and the ShareRecon retirement plan has not yet been scoped.

What I need by Friday 2026-08-14:
- Paul: a one-page view of member service capacity against the digital refresh timeline.
- Kara: updated LoanDesk pipeline targets for Q3 and Q4.
- Wesley: any regulatory items that could shift our sequencing.
- Andre: a realistic date for the ShareRecon retirement scoping.
- Rita: operations dependencies for ACHHub and CardProcessor changes.

Michelle is copied because several initiatives carry staffing and training implications. I will fold everything into the board packet draft.

Thanks for the steady progress.

Gloria

emails.subject: Board packet: HR and staffing sections ready for your review
emails.body:
Hi Gloria,

I have finished the HR section for the August board packet and attached it for your review. It includes the quarterly headcount summary, open requisitions in Lending and Information Technology, turnover trends for the first half of the year, and the training completion status on annual compliance modules.

Two items I would like your guidance on. First, whether you want the succession planning summary included in the open session or held for executive session. Second, how much detail to give on the proposed adjustment to the branch staffing model, since it ties directly to the strategic plan.

Wesley, I have copied you so you can confirm the training completion figures match your records before the packet goes out. The compliance modules are the ones the board will ask about most.

If I can have your comments by Thursday, I can finalize and send everything to the board secretary by the deadline.

Thanks,
Michelle

emails.subject: NCUA exam prep: document requests and readiness walkthroughs
emails.body:
Team,

With the NCUA exam window approaching this fall, I want us fully prepared well ahead of the entrance letter. Wesley is coordinating and will be your main point of contact.

Please plan on the following:
- Each manager should confirm your policies and procedures were reviewed within the last 12 months, and flag anything overdue.
- Andre, please prepare evidence of access reviews, backup testing, and the current incident response plan, including dependencies for CoreBanking and MemberSSO.
- Rita, please gather ACHHub and CardProcessor reconciliation and exception reports for the last two quarters.
- Kara, please make sure underwriting exceptions and LoanDesk approval documentation are organized.
- Paul, please confirm complaint logs and resolution timelines are current.

Wesley will hold 30-minute readiness walkthroughs the week of 2026-08-31. Michelle will help with training records and job descriptions.

Let me know early if you see a gap. I would much rather hear it now.

Gloria

emails.subject: Strategic plan update: September status and revised timeline
emails.body:
Hi everyone,

Thank you for the inputs last month. I have consolidated them and want to share where we landed before the next board cycle.

Key changes to the plan:
- The digital experience refresh moves its pilot to mid-October so OnlineBanking and MemberSSO testing does not collide with exam preparation.
- The indirect auto expansion stays on schedule, with Kara's revised Q4 targets adopted.
- ShareRecon retirement scoping is now due by the end of October, based on Andre's estimate.
- The branch staffing model proposal goes to the board with Michelle's supporting data.

I know the NCUA exam work is stacking up alongside these initiatives, so please tell me if a milestone is unrealistic rather than quietly slipping. We can resequence, but I need to know early.

I will review progress with each of you individually over the next two weeks. A short calendar invite will follow.

Thank you,
Gloria

emails.subject: Board packet: September final checklist and open items
emails.body:
Hi Gloria and Wesley,

Here is where the September board packet stands as of today.

Complete: the CEO report, the strategic plan status summary, the financial dashboard, and the HR and staffing section, including the branch staffing proposal.

Still open:
- Wesley, the compliance and NCUA exam readiness summary. The board will want to know about the readiness walkthrough results and any remediation items.
- Rita, I have asked for the operations metrics page covering ACHHub and CardProcessor exceptions. I have copied her here so she can see the timeline.
- Gloria, your final sign-off on the executive session agenda.

My plan is to assemble the full packet Monday and send it to the board secretary on Tuesday for distribution. If any section will be late, please tell me by end of day Monday so I can adjust.

Thank you both,
Michelle
